capabilities.description: Build and certify Interim Payment Certificates from measured BOQ quantities (document:harbourline_boq.xlsx items P1-P5, E1-E5), applying the 5% retention under Clause 14.3 of document:harbourline_contract.pdf and producing claim lines traceable to each BOQ item.

Track elapsed time against the 730-day Time for Completion (Clause 8.2) and compute liquidated delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day, capped at 10% (Clause 8.7) of document:harbourline_contract.pdf, with certificate-ready audit evidence.

Record inspection and test plan (ITP) hold points and QA sign-offs for earthworks and civil activities tied to the BOQ scope in document:harbourline_boq.xlsx, preserving each record as auditable evidence for taking-over and the Defects Notification Period (Clause 11.1).

Maintain the project document register with version control and provenance for the contract and BOQ source-of-record files, plus incoming and outgoing project correspondence, so every claim, QA record, and delay calculation can cite its source document.

Answer clause queries against document:harbourline_contract.pdf (retention, performance security, defects notification, delay damages) with grounded citations and refusal when the source does not support an answer.

Track 5% retention held per interim certificate, the 50% release at Taking-Over and 50% at end of the Defects Notification Period (Clause 14.3), and the 10% Performance Security (Clause 4.2) of document:harbourline_contract.pdf.

summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project that uses the uploaded contract (document:harbourline_contract.pdf) and BOQ (document:harbourline_boq.xlsx) as its source of record. It serves the project's commercial and engineering controls teams by managing progress claims against BOQ items, tracking delay damages against Clause 8.7, maintaining QA/ITP records, and holding a single document register, all with auditable provenance back to the source documents.
